headline.zh: 为 Dust 创建知识查询 agent
headline.en: Create a knowledge query agent in Dust

scenario.zh: 团队需要快速从内部文档找到项目答案，构建一个连接知识库的 agent 来自动检索相关内容
scenario.en: Team needs to quickly find project answers from internal docs; build an agent connecting knowledge bases to auto-retrieve relevant content

instruction.zh: 选择 agent 可以查询的知识来源
instruction.en: Choose knowledge source the agent can query

output.zh: agent 将检索产品规格与技术决策
output.en: Agent will retrieve product specs and technical decisions

input.zh: 我们的 API 速率限制是多少？
input.en: What is our API rate limit?

output.zh: 根据架构文档第 12 页：默认限制为每秒 100 次请求，企业客户可提升至 500 次
output.en: Per architecture doc page 12: default limit is 100 requests/second, enterprise customers can increase to 500

output.zh: agent 将查找历史工单与解决方案
output.en: Agent will find historical tickets and solutions

input.zh: 如何处理支付失败的退款？
input.en: How to handle refunds for failed payments?

output.zh: 根据工单 #3847 处理记录：失败支付在 24 小时内自动退回原支付方式，客户无需额外操作
output.en: Per ticket #3847 resolution: failed payments automatically refund to original method within 24 hours, no customer action needed

instruction.zh: 决定 agent 如何组织检索到的信息
instruction.en: Decide how agent organizes retrieved information

output.zh: 提供简洁答案并标注原始文档位置
output.en: Provide concise answer with original doc location

output.zh: 并列展示不同文档中的相关内容
output.en: Show side-by-side content from different docs

output.zh: 返回文档中最相关的完整段落
output.en: Return most relevant complete paragraph from doc

instruction.zh: 在 Dust 平台提问验证 agent 效果
instruction.en: Ask test question on Dust platform to verify agent performance

label.zh: 提问并检查来源准确性

output.zh: 需在 Dust 实际运行 agent 来确认检索质量与答案可靠性
output.en: Must run agent on actual Dust to confirm retrieval quality and answer reliability

takeaway.zh: 演示了从虚构知识库检索答案的流程；真实检索准确性、多源整合能力需在 Dust 平台配置实际数据源后验证；前往 dust.tt 连接团队知识并部署 agent
takeaway.en: Illustrated workflow retrieving answers from fictional knowledge base; real retrieval accuracy and multi-source integration require configuring actual data sources on Dust platform; visit dust.tt to connect team knowledge and deploy agent
